verdict.rationale: Anytype's own docs claim you can 'collaborate with others without sacrificing your privacy' and 'collaborate directly with others using peer-to-peer sync or self-host' [anytype-docs-12, anytype-docs-39, anytype-docs-33], suggesting shared spaces and multi-person editing. However, independent community evidence directly contradicts this: a Notion employee notes Anytype 'still lacks collaboration' [anytype-comm-3], and another user states 'you can't share with others yet' [anytype-comm-15], indicating the sharing/collaboration capability was not functional or available in hands-on use. Missing for 10: concrete first-party or independent evidence of real-time multi-user editing with conflict resolution (CRDT merge behavior), and no recent hands-on report confirming collaborative editing actually works without conflicts.
